Khurshed Alam, aged about 25 years, (Male) Son of Mahruddin Mian @
 Machharddin Mian, Resident of Village- Nandpur Parsauna, Police Station  Sangrampur, District- East Champaran.

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Tiwari, Advocate  For the State : Mr. Syed Ehteshamuddin, A.P.P.
For the Informant : Mr. Waliur Rahman, Advocate

======================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PURNENDU SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 04-12-2024 Heard Mr. Sanjay Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner; Mr. Waliur Rahman, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant and Mr. Syed Ehteshamuddin,
learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Sangrampur P.S. Case No. 111 of 2024 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The allegation against the petitioner is of assaulting the informant for non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.80350 of 2024(2) dt.04-12-2024 4.
Both the parties have jointly informed that they are ready to reconcile their matrimonial relationship outside the court by way of mediation.

5. Considering the desire of the parties and the fact that the FIR has been lodged as a result of the strained matrimonial relationship between the informant and the petitioner, who are wife and Khurshed Alam vs The State Of Bihar on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18886972/
1 husband respectively, I find it proper to direct the learned Mediator, District Mediation Centre, to resolve the dispute between the husband and the wife and submit a report before the learned District Court well within a period of four months.

sentences.text: 6. Both the parties are directed to appear before the learned Mediator, District Mediation Centre on 22.01.2025 at 04:30 PM.

7. The petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on pre-arrest bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, East Champaran, Motihari/ successor Court, in connection with Sangrampur P.S. Case No. 111 of 2024, subject to the condition as laid down under Section Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.80350 of 2024(2) dt.04-12-2024 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
8.
The bail application stands disposed of.

(Purnendu Singh, J) Niraj/-
